subject: Looking for the BCOV (SPSS) equivalent in R

messages.author: 7b7730c38a6eaeef
messages.subject: Looking for the BCOV (SPSS) equivalent in R
parts:
Hello all, 

I am trying to replicate a research method and looking for the BCOV equivalent in R. BOCV gives the Variance-covariance matrix for unstandardized regression coefficients. 

Is the vcov command, using standardized= false enough to get the same variance-covariance matrix of the regression coefficients?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Looking for the BCOV (SPSS) equivalent in R
parts: Is the vcov command, using standardized= false enough to get the same variance-covariance matrix of the regression coefficients?

The vcov() method will give you the covariance matrix of all estimated parameters, including any regression slopes in your model.  There is no standardized= argument for that method.  See the help page:

class?lavaan

It occurs to me you might not be using lavaan at all.  This is a lavaan forum, not a general R forum, but yes, lm objects also have a vcov() method that returns what you are looking for.

?vcov
